We need to produce a test class for NumericIndicator.previous(int) method, based on template. Should include necessary imports, set up mocks, instantiate NumericIndicator with a delegate indicator (e.g., ClosePriceIndicator) using a MockBarSeries. Use @BeforeAll etc.

We need to test that previous(int) returns a NumericIndicator wrapping a PreviousValueIndicator that shifts values by barCount. In existing test they used numericIndicator.previous() and previous(3). We'll replicate similar but using JUnit5 and Mockito as per template.

We should not invoke private methods/fields. Use NumericIndicator.of(delegate). previous(barCount) returns NumericIndicator. Then get underlying Indicator via .previous(barCount) returns Indicator<Num>. Actually method signature: public NumericIndicator previous(int barCount) returns NumericIndicator. So we can call numericIndicator.previous(3) which returns NumericIndicator; then get its delegate? Not needed; we can call getValue on returned NumericIndicator and compare to original delegate shifted.

But NumericIndicator implements Indicator<Num>, so we can treat as Indicator. So test: NumericIndicator numeric = NumericIndicator.of(cp1); NumericIndicator prev = numeric.previous(3); assertEquals(cp1.getValue(3), prev.getValue(6)); also test edge cases like barCount=0 maybe returns same? Not defined but we can test barCount=1.

Set up series using MockBarSeries similar to original test. Need function numFunction. In JUnit5 we can use @ParameterizedTest? But we can just create a static function using a lambda. In original test they used AbstractIndicatorTest which provides numFunction. Here we don't have that. We can use org.ta4j.core.num.DecimalNum? Or use a simple implementation via MockBarSeries constructor expects Function<Number, Num>. In tests we can use org.ta4j.core.num.DecimalNum::valueOf? Actually DecimalNum has static valueOf(Number). So we can do Function<Number, Num> numFunction = DecimalNum::valueOf; Need import DecimalNum.

Alternatively we can mock Indicator<Num> using Mockito to return known values for getValue. Simpler: use MockBarSeries and ClosePriceIndicator as in original. We'll need to instantiate MockBarSeries with numFunction and values. Use same series.

Thus in @BeforeAll we can create static series and cp1 etc. But need numFunction static variable. We'll set static BarSeries series; static ClosePriceIndicator cp; static NumericIndicator numeric;

In @BeforeAll we can initialize series using new MockBarSeries(numFunction, ...). Need import MockBarSeries.

Implementation:

@BeforeAll static void setupBeforeAll() { numFunction = DecimalNum::valueOf; series = new MockBarSeries(numFunction, 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,8,7,6,5,4,3,2,1,0,-1,-2); cp = new ClosePriceIndicator(series); }

But numFunction variable can be static Function<Number, Num>. We'll declare static fields.

Then in test method:

@Test void testPreviousWithBarCount() { NumericIndicator numeric = NumericIndicator.of(cp); NumericIndicator prev = numeric.previous(3); // shift by 3

assertEquals(cp.getValue(3), prev.getValue(6)); // index 6 = 3+3

Also test barCount 1: NumericIndicator prev1 = numeric.previous(1); assertEquals(cp.getValue(0), prev1.getValue(1));

Edge: index out of range? Not needed.

Add assertions using assertEquals with Num equality? Use assertEquals from JUnit5 but need to compare Num objects; better use assertEquals with Num's equals method? Use assertEquals(cp.getValue(3), prev.getValue(6)); Should work.

Add import for org.junit.jupiter.api.Test.

Also ensure no private method usage.
